statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval
